title: DDB Scenes for Plutonium
description: Populates scenes imported with Plutonium with the monsters and NPCs placed by the DDB Importer community scene data, using official D&D compendiums (default) or Plutonium imports with dynamic token rings. Pair it with the Aiacos/plutonium-scenes data repository, which also adds the community lights and walls.

recommends.reason: Imports the scenes this module populates, and supplies creatures in Plutonium mode.
When active, its official-compendium selection is reused.
